changelog: v1.1.7 - Live Update content/eligibility fixes for the attendance notification, and an update-sheet scroll fix
features: Attendance notification now splits into "Working" (status) and "Punched in ..." (detail), matching Android's Live Update content shape
Attendance notification channel raised from Low to Default importance, which Android 16 requires for Live Update eligibility
Attendance notification now requests Android 16's formal Live Update (promoted ongoing) treatment, on top of the Samsung/Android compact pill it already had
Punching out now leaves a one-time "Work completed" summary (punch-in time and hours worked) instead of just clearing the notification
The update sheet's "What's new" list no longer pushes the download progress bar out of view on a long changelog
